covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the regular U.S. market close on Friday, October 2, 2026, plus companies reporting before the next U.S. market open on Monday, October 5, 2026.

market_context_summary: September payroll growth slowed to 29,000, prior months were revised down by a combined 60,000, and unemployment rose to 4.2%. Stocks rose and Treasury yields fell as the report reduced pressure for an aggressive Federal Reserve rate increase, while the weak labor signal remains a growth risk.

methodology.consensus_basis: All three independent passes operated on the same empty qualified universe; no company-level averages were calculable.
methodology.disparity_definition: A 0-100 measure of disagreement among three independent company scores and reversal-risk assessments; not applicable when no company qualifies.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Reviewed the cumulative timing-confirmation, key-metric, expectation-bar, forward-look, and reversal-risk lessons. The repeated hard timing-confirmation rule excluded all raw entries; no new method change was warranted.

research_allocation_view.rationale: No company entered the qualified universe, so none could satisfy the consensus score, reversal-risk, confidence, and evidence-quality gates.
